_about: PLACEHOLDER lines for the ore-train opening (docs/maps/ore_train.md) and the crate scene stand-in, in the grim tone (docs/tone_guide.md): dry, short, tired; the heroes stay loud. Written by the Gameplay Programmer as stand-ins until the Writer's M6-2 pass.

train_open_1.speaker: narrator
train_open_1.text: Night on the Harrow ore line. Black harbor water on one side, ore stacks on the other.

train_open_1.speaker: narrator
train_open_1.text: Ahead, the stacked slums of Harrow Landing glow like a held breath.

train_open_2.speaker: narrator
train_open_2.text: Red sits on a crate with a chalked lantern on the lid. Watch Zero's order: thermoses, cushions, sleeve bells.

train_open_3.speaker: sign
train_open_3.text: SIGNALS INSPECTION. REMAIN WHERE YOU ARE.

train_open_3.speaker: narrator
train_open_3.text: Flashlights at the rear of the train. Red is already on her feet.

train_hut_1.speaker: crowd_inspector
train_hut_1.text: Scanner says you're contraband. ...Don't look at the crate.

train_hut_1.speaker: crowd_inspector
train_hut_1.text: The paperwork is a formality. So is this fight. Hold still.

train_hut_2.speaker: narrator
train_hut_2.text: The inspector holds up a white flag. Then, slowly, a form for the white flag.

train_box_1.speaker: narrator
train_box_1.text: Red hauls the boxcar door shut behind her. A beat of dark and wheel clatter.

train_box_1.speaker: narrator
train_box_1.text: The door rolls open again. Two scanners come through, cones first.

train_box_2.speaker: crowd_inspector_b
train_box_2.text: So does everybody. Sweep it anyway.

train_ditch_1.speaker: narrator
train_ditch_1.text: The scanners are beeping at the crate. Red looks at it. At the cones. At the open door.

train_ditch_1.speaker: narrator
train_ditch_1.text: Watch Zero's bells will have to find their own way home. She shoves.

train_ditch_2.speaker: narrator
train_ditch_2.text: A splash, and the harbor takes it. The freight platform's lights slide into view, one at a time.

train_land.speaker: narrator
train_land.text: Red hits the freight platform rolling. Over the Landing, the Quiet Hours siren starts up: eight bright notes at a dark town.

train_ditch_after.speaker: narrator
train_ditch_after.text: The harbor is where the crate is now.

train_ditch_empty.speaker: narrator
train_ditch_empty.text: The open door. Cold air, black water, the platform lights. Nothing here to throw.

train_ex_crate.speaker: narrator
train_ex_crate.text: Watch Zero's order. Thermoses, cushions, sleeve bells. The bells are the problem.

train_ex_lights.speaker: narrator
train_ex_lights.text: The slums of Harrow Landing, stacked up the hillside. About half the windows are lit.

train_ex_ore.speaker: narrator
train_ex_ore.text: Ore, heaped past a man's head. Harrow's quota, headed off-moon.

train_ex_stencil.speaker: narrator
train_ex_stencil.text: A quota stencil on the bin wall. Someone has crossed out the number and written a smaller one.

harrow_home_arrival.speaker: narrator
harrow_home_arrival.text: The siren is still going. Red runs in, crosses the room, and lights the lamp anyway.

harrow_home_arrival.speaker: narrator
harrow_home_arrival.text: She has never missed a night.
